name: Buea

queries.query: Buea Cameroon official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry cadastre
queries.result: Search found the official Cameroon Geoportal, the official Buea Council website, and national MINDCAF material, but no Buea parcel layer or public cadastral feature-query endpoint.

queries.query: Cameroon Buea cadastre parcelles carte cadastrale géoportail officiel
queries.result: Search found the official Cameroon Geoportal and MINDCAF documents describing national land/cadastre administration, plus an official MINHDU Buea land-use-plan document; no public Buea parcel geometry service was found.

registryBasis: National MINDCAF land/cadastre authority and the official Buea Council/MINHDU land-use documents were evidenced, but no city-local cadastral registry endpoint, parcel map, or bounded parcel response was verified. National agency prose is not treated as a Buea registry finding.

officialSources.observation: Public bilingual Cameroon Geospatial Data Portal. Its dataset catalogue returned 109 datasets, including administrative boundaries and land-use layers, but no parcel/cadastre dataset.
officialSources.scope: national geospatial portal; not verified cadastral coverage

officialSources.observation: Official Ministry of Domains, Cadastre and Land Affairs site; establishes the national agency context only.
Official public procedures/documents page describes land, domain and cadastral procedures and departmental/regional processing, but does not expose Buea parcel geometry or an anonymous map API.
Official Buea Council website; city authority evidence, but no public cadastral viewer or parcel service was found in the fetched page.
Official MINHDU Land Use Plan of the Municipality of Buea. It is planning/land-use documentation, not parcel-level cadastral geometry.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The Cameroon Geoportal catalogue is national and its administrative-boundary metadata states national ADM0-ADM3 coverage; this is not parcel coverage.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No open Buea parcel layer or parcel feature response verified.
